name: digi-infrastructure PCS (SQLite dev)
install: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd pcs && uv sync --extra dev

terminals.name: pcs-server
terminals.description: PCS FastAPI server in lightweight dev mode (SQLite via aiosqlite, debug on so /docs is served). Health at /api/v1/health/, Swagger UI at /docs.
terminals.command: cd pcs && source .pcs-dev-env.sh && uv run uvicorn pcs.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
